row.evidence: Unleash's pricing FAQ says the free Open Source edition "does not include single sign-on, SCIM provisioning" and that "Pay-As-You-Go starts at $75 per seat per month"; Pay-As-You-Go and Enterprise "both give you the full Enterprise feature set".
row.notes: The cheapest paid plan, Pay-As-You-Go ($75 per seat per month, billed monthly by card, no annual price listed), carries the full Enterprise feature set including SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM, so there is no SCIM upcharge over the team plan. The free self-hosted Open Source edition has no SSO or SCIM. Enterprise is an annual contract (Contact Sales). Self-hosted Pay-As-You-Go has a 5-seat minimum. SCIM (v6.1+) covers users and groups but not role mapping: synced users default to Viewer and deprovisioned users are soft-deleted. Okta and Entra are set up as custom apps with the SCIM URL and token from the Unleash UI. Monthly price recorded because no annual price is published.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Limited to 1 project, 2 environments and 5,000 flags.

plans.name: Pay-As-You-Go
plans.price_text: $75 per seat per month, billed monthly by credit card

auth.token_source: Admin settings > Single sign-on > SCIM tab (toggle on; token shown); can be regenerated via POST /api/admin/scim-settings/generate-new-token
auth.notes: Okta uses HTTP Header auth with the token; Entra uses it as the Secret Token.

operations.notes: Okta: Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users, Push Groups. Whether updates use PUT or PATCH is not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Users are soft-deleted so audit logs are preserved

attributes.notes: Attributes the Okta and Entra guides say to keep; all others should be removed from the mapping.

roles.how: No role mapping; SCIM users default to Viewer. Admin rights come from assigning a role to a synced group in Unleash.

limitations.text: No role mapping or password sync; SCIM-synced users default to the Viewer root role and manual role changes are reset on the next sync.
Entra deprovisioning needs the aadOptscim062020 SCIM compliance flag on the tenant URL.
Okta has no catalogue app: SCIM is enabled on a custom SWA (or existing SAML) app.

scim.notes: SCIM is an Enterprise feature (v6.1+); both paid plans (Pay-As-You-Go and Enterprise) carry the full Enterprise feature set. Not in Unleash Open Source. The SCIM URL is shown in Admin > Single Sign-On > SCIM; its path pattern is not documented. Version 2.0 is implied by the generic SCIM setup rather than stated.

auth.notes: Service-account tokens or personal access tokens in the Authorization header; permissions follow the token owner's role.

capabilities.notes: Create user takes a rootRole and an optional welcome email (sendEmail).

endpoints.purpose: Get all users and root roles

audit_log_api.notes: Event log is readable via GET /api/admin/events.

okta.notes: No catalogue app is used: the guide creates a custom SWA app (or reuses a custom SAML app) and adds SCIM.

entra.notes: Uses the customer's own Entra SSO app (non-gallery) with the Unleash SCIM URL and token.

fallbacks.other_sync: SSO group syncing (OIDC/SAML group claims mapped to Unleash groups)
fallbacks.notes: Docs list user group SSO syncing guides; JIT account creation on SSO login is not quoted here.
